title: DotAgents Lifecycle Hooks Configuration
description: Schema for .dotagents/hooks.jsonc — single source of truth for AI agent lifecycle hooks (PreToolUse, Stop, etc.). Deployed to 18 providers via per-provider Handlebars templates.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor tooling (VSCode, Zed, etc.).

hooks.description: Array of hook definitions. A single hooks.jsonc deploys to all targeted providers; each provider's hooks.hbs template silently drops events/types it does not support.

name.description: Stable identifier for the hook (used by some providers for dedup or display).

description.description: Human-readable purpose (comments in source are preferred for security hooks).

event.description: Lifecycle event name. Canonical events (~30 known + open string for provider extensions): PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, PostCompact, PermissionRequest, PostToolUseFailure, StopFailure, BeforeModel, AfterModel, BeforeAgent, AfterAgent, BeforeToolSelection, BeforeTool, AfterTool, PreCompress, BeforeShellExecution, AfterShellExecution, BeforeMCPExecution, AfterMCPExecution, BeforeReadFile, AfterFileEdit, BeforeSubmitPrompt, AfterAgentResponse, AfterAgentThought, PreInvocation, PostInvocation, workspaceOpen, beforeTabFileRead, afterTabFileEdit, Interrupt, PermissionResult, PermissionDenied, SetUpEnvironment, and others. Templates filter which events they emit.

matcher.description: Tool name glob or prefix (e.g. 'Bash', 'mcp__*'). Provider-specific semantics.

enabled.description: When false the entire hook entry is omitted from all deployed output (no per-provider override).

type.description: Handler kind. Templates drop types they do not support (e.g. cursor drops mcp_tool).

command.description: Shell command for type=command (POSIX). Use commandWindows for Windows override.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Use {{timeout_to_seconds timeout}} in sec-based templates (ceiling div).

onFailure.description: Policy when the hook itself errors.

env.description: Environment variables injected for this hook execution.

loopLimit.description: Max iterations for loop-style hooks (cursor, crush, qwencode).

statusMessage.description: Progress UI text shown while hook runs (some providers).

async.description: Fire-and-forget. Dropped (treated sync) by providers that do not support async.

tool.description: Tool name to invoke for type=mcp_tool.
